text:
EBIT margin guidance for Wires & Cables business – maintain medium‑to‑long‑term margin guidance of 11% to 13% (FY 2027 onward).  
EBITDA margin target for FMEG business – aim for EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.  
Capital expenditure – no forward‑looking capex guidance was provided; the company only disclosed the INR 3.2 billion capex for the quarter ended June 30 2026.
